homonyms.basis: No card carries the phrase or the concept for another object: all five are the archive's own or authored surfaces. The public entity Marxism, on which the archive bears with ρ = extends, is the neighbour row marxism (AXN:0714 by the resolver's relation, F15); the archive concept semantic liquidation is the neighbour row semantic-liquidation, built in parallel. Neither is a homonym: each is a related archive object.

internal.semantic liquidation: four dated senses of one archive term, each composed with its source: #18 (2026-02-20) a platform's ingestion stripping meaning of context into statistical patterns (MI18-01); #501 (2026-02-21) the sign's conversion into 'tokens of identity and brand' (MI501-07); #517 (2026-02-26) the disqualification of analysis exceeding an institution's interpretive norms (MI517-05); #595 (2026-03-21) the extraction of meaning from the commons, ten operations (MI595-03). T2's 'approach that breaks down rigid or dogmatic category boundaries' is no sense of the archive's and is carried in the delta as a substituted reading.

captures.description: THE FAILURE OF MARXISM AS IDENTITY: the AI Overview gives the phrase to 'I Hereby Abolish Rules: Semantic Liquidation, Territorial Gatekeeping, and the Failure of Marxism as Identity' by Lee Sharks (#517, AXN:0154, through Google Scholar and the resolver), generalizes its case (two works removed from r/LeftistsForAI) into a critique of Marxism as tribal identity, and defines semantic liquidation as 'an approach that breaks down rigid or dogmatic category boundaries' — the framework's name for extraction turned into the work's method.
